stem.text: What is **not** a reasonable estimate of the physical property indicated?

A.text: $2 \times 10^{3}\,\text{W}$ for the power dissipated by the heating element of an electric kettle

B.text: $4 \times 10^{2}\,\text{m}^{3}$ for the volume of water in a swimming pool

C.text: $5 \times 10^{5}\,\text{Ns}$ for the momentum of a lorry moving along a road

D.text: $6 \times 10^{2}\,\text{N}$ for the weight of a fully grown racehorse
